summary: Meta AI's Alexandr Wang announced the public release of Muse Spark 1.3 max, a new variant claimed to have stronger coding and agentic performance than the existing 1.3 high and xhigh versions.

practices.reason: The claim of stronger coding and agentic performance is stated but not backed by a specific benchmark figure, so it merits checking against our own workloads before switching.
practices.quote: we see significantly stronger coding and agentic performance on muse spark 1.3 max, so would strongly recommend trying it out even if you've already tried muse spark 1.3 high or muse spark 1.3 xhigh.
